population.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

endpoint.span: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, or coronary revascularization (to assess effects on major cardiovascular events)

treatment_strategy.span: Participants will be randomly assigned to oral atorvastatin (40 mg daily) or matching placebo (1:1 ratio).

absent_reason: analysis_set: The protocol specifies planned intention-to-treat comparisons, but no held results source explicitly states the analysis population used for the reported estimate.
served_mismatch: The served HR and confidence limits match the results abstract. However, the requested estimand is RR, whereas the reported estimate is HR; these are not interchangeable. The served intention-to-treat designation is supported only as a protocol plan, not explicitly confirmed for the reported result.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population comprises adults aged ≥70 years without clinical cardiovascular disease.
entry_population_matches_question.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

notes: The results abstract supplies the estimate and its endpoint definition, which includes coronary revascularization. The protocol and baseline full texts describe a narrower cardiovascular composite without revascularization and cannot substitute for the reported endpoint. No registry spans were needed.
